Results.ReviewText:
This grill is just alright, but it's WAY overpriced. I bought the Spirit E-310 expecting a major step up in quality or consistency, but this grill doesn't do anything better than any competitor I've used. 

With the new model, the back of the grill stand is basically open. The holes still exist to screw in a full sized plate, but the back plate is about a quarter of the size it should be. This means that even with the lid closed, you can't grill with low flame on a windy day without the flames going out. I've never had this issue with any other LP grill. 

Also, the customer support is terrible. I had to repeat information multiple time. The issue took multiple weeks to resolve. The resolution was essentially "sucks to be you," and the case was immediately closed so that I couldn't escalate my complaint.
Results.Title: Not Worth The Price Tag, Not Worth The Hype

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my Spirit E-310 grill. This is the third Weber grill that I have purchased. I am still usuing the weber genisis that I purchased in 1996. I gave away my Spirit E210 in order to buy the 3 burner E-310. The E-310 has excellent temerature control and can quickly reach 600 deg.

Results.ReviewText: Not worth the money, burner valve failed at 3 years, grill only has 2 year warranty. So expect to have to buy more Chinese parts from them after purchase. Almost 200 dollars quoted from Weber to replace burner valve a knob that got stripped because of failed burner valve and the igniter that broke. I did purchase aftermarket burner valve on Amazon for much cheaper and fixed my problem but for a grill that cost over 500 bucks you would expect it to last a lot longer. I thought the Weber name meant quality. Should have bought a cheaper grill and expected things to fail.
Results.Title: Not worth the cost, only a 2 year warranty!

Results.ReviewText: Can't say enough about this grill. Picked it up as a floor model special from the store that rhymes with Owe's. Even heating over the whole grill surface, and great temp control. It could benefit from a slightly bigger warming rack, and better design of the grill tool "hooks" ( the hooks aren't really useful at all), but that's about it. I like the extra storage space underneath, and it's easy to get the grease traps out for cleaning. Bigger than the 210, which would be fine for a really small space, but not as bulky as the larger models. Perfect fit for me.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for a small family or limited space

Have had the E-310 for 6 weeks and have used at least 6 times. It is easy to start and operate.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
